{{Top|leg}}
The '''Historian Corp''' was a special squad in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] led by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Arhul Hextrophon/Legends|Arhul Hextrophon]]. The Historian Corp was charged with recording the Alliance's battle against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to preserve a record of their efforts and accomplishments. [[Assistant Historian]] [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] was also a member.
